description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass used in Android applications to display log messages within a scrollable view. It includes methods to initialize and customize the log view, handle view creation, and manage text updates to ensure the latest log entries are visible.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages a log display using a custom LogView inside a ScrollView, and handles updating the view with new log entries.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, style, padding, and gravity, then returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment’s lifecycle method to inflate views, set a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and return the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used in the fragment for external access.
